---
title: Search key conflict in HTML
format:
  html: default
filters:
  - veil
extensions:
  veil:
    keys:
      menu: "/"
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        warnings: exhaustive
    html:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        - level: WARN
          regex: "The key '/' of keys.menu is the same as a key of Reveal.js or Quarto"
          count: 1
---
